style: Chinese xianxia / wuxia fantasy RPG soundtrack, traditional Chinese instruments: bamboo flute (dizi), guzheng, xiao (vertical flute), pipa, erhu; haunting and elegant; suitable for elementary-school classroom educational context; no harsh percussion; mid-low tempo for focus

jobs.name: bgm_lobby
jobs.prompt: calm lobby music loop while waiting for a peer to join, soft guzheng arpeggios + distant xiao, mid tempo ~90 bpm, atmospheric and inviting, not sleepy

jobs.name: bgm_lobby_flac
jobs.prompt: calm lobby music loop while waiting for a peer to join, soft guzheng arpeggios + distant xiao, mid tempo ~90 bpm, atmospheric and inviting, not sleepy

jobs.name: bgm_main
jobs.prompt: in-game loop while the idiom chain is being built, dizi melody over light guzheng pizzicato, mid tempo ~110 bpm, focus-friendly, rhythmic but unobtrusive, slight momentum as the chain grows

jobs.name: bgm_main_flac
jobs.prompt: in-game loop while the idiom chain is being built, dizi melody over light guzheng pizzicato, mid tempo ~110 bpm, focus-friendly, rhythmic but unobtrusive, slight momentum as the chain grows

jobs.name: sfx_correct
jobs.prompt: triumphant short rising dizi motif, four notes ascending major scale (5-6-1-2 in solfege), bright and crisp, no percussion, ~1s

jobs.name: sfx_wrong
jobs.prompt: low gong hit 'dong', short dull thud, low pitch around 110Hz with quick decay, no melody, ~0.8s

jobs.name: sfx_fail
jobs.prompt: xiao flute descending melancholy phrase over soft low drum, three descending notes, ~1.5s, signaling the chain has broken

jobs.name: sfx_success
jobs.prompt: celebratory pipa flourish + wind chimes, ascending pentatonic phrase 1-2-3-5-6 with ringing chime overtones, ~2s, warm and positive

jobs.name: sfx_finish
jobs.prompt: triumphant xianxia victory jingle, full dizi melody over guzheng strum + cymbal swell, bright major key, climax and resolve, designed to be short (~6s) when truncated
